note: Five adjudicated variants: four of the orthography class — four words the two witnesses spell differently, each spelling a real one — and one misplaced accent in witness do. There is no substantive divergence beyond them, and no accidental comparison against tpl, whose profile is substantive-only.

adjudicated.ruling: Evæ, with do. Both spellings are the same name: the Vulgate itself sets Hava at Genesis 3, 20 and Eva elsewhere, and the h is a Hebrew breathing that Latin took over unevenly. The corpus prints what its 1962 witness prints and records the other page rather than correcting it.

Lacrymárum, with do. Both spellings are real: lacrima is the Latin word and lacryma the spelling that spread when Greek y was felt to suit it. Whitaker's Words carries only the i-spelling and Collatinus heads both, which is why the token names Collatinus alone.

The j-form against this edition's i-form, by the house rule in ORTHOGRAPHY.md. This edition prints i because the books it edits do: the 1962 typical edition sets Iesu, Ioánnem, iube and maiestátis throughout, and so does the Ordo Missae of Pallottinum, Poznań 1963, which is the book a Polish reader is most likely to hold. The mid-century hand missals print j; neither spelling is a different word, and the apparatus records theirs.
Exílium, with do. Both spellings are real — exsilium keeps the s of ex, exilium assimilates it — and the dictionaries head both. Both analyzers link the assimilated form, which is the corpus's lemma.

María, with do's own setting of the name three lines above (Ave María) and with every other María in this corpus. The i of Maria is long, so the stress falls on it; do's Mária in this one line puts the accent on the wrong syllable.

Génetrix, against do and with witness tpl, which prints Genetrix, and with the corpus rulings at ordinarium.communicantes w011 and ordinarium.libera-nos w020: genetrix is the older form of the same noun from gigno, genitrix the one that spread later, and one spelling is kept throughout the corpus. The ruling at libera-nos already noted that do sets Genitrice in these very prayers.
